units.rawText:
Inside the Operand Black Hole.
Chaotic data streams around Persicaria's frail form. She struggles toward the heart of the black hole.
units.displayText:

Inside the Operand Black Hole.

units.rawText: (...That was close, I nearly lost myself in my memories.)
units.displayText: ...That was close, I nearly lost myself in my memories.

spans.text: ...That was close, I nearly lost myself in my memories.

units.rawText: (But that white figure I saw at the end...)
units.displayText: But that white figure I saw at the end...

spans.text: But that white figure I saw at the end...

units.rawText: Persicaria recalls the figure in question.
units.displayText: Persicaria recalls the figure in question.

spans.text: Persicaria recalls the figure in question.

units.rawText: (...To ENIAC, that ought to have been Neumann. Does he really mean that much to her?)
units.displayText: ...To ENIAC, that ought to have been Neumann. Does he really mean that much to her?

spans.text: ...To ENIAC, that ought to have been Neumann. Does he really mean that much to her?

units.rawText: (...And to me, that figure was...)
units.displayText: ...And to me, that figure was...

spans.text: ...And to me, that figure was...

units.rawText:
The Residents, the Sanctifiers, unknown programs that are writhing masses of black and purple... All kinds of garbled images show up in the data streams, and the operand fluctuations pound at Persicaria's neural cloud.
Persicaria tries her best to maintain her consciousness and determine the right path to take.

The Residents, the Sanctifiers, unknown programs that are writhing masses of black and purple... All kinds of garbled images show up in the data streams, and the operand fluctuations pound at Persicaria's neural cloud.
Persicaria tries her best to maintain her consciousness and determine the right path to take.

units.rawText: (As I thought... There's just too much pressure on my neural cloud...)
units.displayText: As I thought... There's just too much pressure on my neural cloud...

spans.text: As I thought... There's just too much pressure on my neural cloud...

units.rawText: (Coughs heavily)
units.displayText: Coughs heavily

spans.text: Coughs heavily

units.rawText: Persicaria unconsciously grabs at her chest and finds that her hand is starting to crumble into operand fragments that scatter and join the wild torrent of data around her.
units.displayText: Persicaria unconsciously grabs at her chest and finds that her hand is starting to crumble into operand fragments that scatter and join the wild torrent of data around her.

spans.text: Persicaria unconsciously grabs at her chest and finds that her hand is starting to crumble into operand fragments that scatter and join the wild torrent of data around her.

units.rawText: (I need to hurry...)
units.displayText: I need to hurry...

spans.text: I need to hurry...

units.rawText: At the heart of the black hole, countless data streams surround a single computer.
units.displayText: At the heart of the black hole, countless data streams surround a single computer.

spans.text: At the heart of the black hole, countless data streams surround a single computer.

units.rawText: (Is that... ENIAC...)
units.displayText: Is that... ENIAC...

spans.text: Is that... ENIAC...

units.rawText: ENIAC!
units.displayText: ENIAC!

spans.text: ENIAC!

units.rawText: (No response...?)
units.displayText: No response...?

spans.text: No response...?

units.rawText: (Then I'll go with what we talked about before and use administrator access to perform a base layer operation on her...)
units.displayText: Then I'll go with what we talked about before and use administrator access to perform a base layer operation on her...

spans.text: Then I'll go with what we talked about before and use administrator access to perform a base layer operation on her...

units.rawText: [Please enter password. Password error will trigger emergency mode.]
units.displayText: [Please enter password. Password error will trigger emergency mode.]

spans.text: [Please enter password. Password error will trigger emergency mode.]

units.rawText: A password?
units.displayText: A password?

spans.text: A password?

units.rawText: Using administrator permissions to perform mandatory access control (MAC) operation...
units.displayText: Using administrator permissions to perform mandatory access control (MAC) operation...

spans.text: Using administrator permissions to perform mandatory access control (MAC) operation...

units.rawText:
<color=red>[MAC access detected, activating emergency mode.]</color>
<color=red>[MAC access detected, activating emergency mode.]</color>
<color=red>[MAC access detected, activating emergency mode.]</color>
units.displayText:

units.rawText: The computer glows red and the phantasmal images within the data streams instantly take on reality, lunging at Persicaria with speed that the eye can't follow.
units.displayText: The computer glows red and the phantasmal images within the data streams instantly take on reality, lunging at Persicaria with speed that the eye can't follow.

spans.text: The computer glows red and the phantasmal images within the data streams instantly take on reality, lunging at Persicaria with speed that the eye can't follow.

units.rawText: Urgh—
units.displayText: Urgh—

spans.text: Urgh—

units.rawText: (I can't withstand these... I need to think of a way to communicate with ENIAC.)
units.displayText: I can't withstand these... I need to think of a way to communicate with ENIAC.

spans.text: I can't withstand these... I need to think of a way to communicate with ENIAC.

units.rawText: (I'll just have to give it a try.)
units.displayText: I'll just have to give it a try.

spans.text: I'll just have to give it a try.

units.rawText: Persicaria connects her neural cloud to the computer system. In that moment, she sees a patch of darkness that is completely different from the interior of the operand black hole.
units.displayText: Persicaria connects her neural cloud to the computer system. In that moment, she sees a patch of darkness that is completely different from the interior of the operand black hole.

spans.text: Persicaria connects her neural cloud to the computer system. In that moment, she sees a patch of darkness that is completely different from the interior of the operand black hole.

units.rawText: And within it sits ENIAC, her eyes dull.
units.displayText: And within it sits ENIAC, her eyes dull.

spans.text: And within it sits ENIAC, her eyes dull.

units.rawText: Consume... consume... consume...
units.displayText: Consume... consume... consume...

spans.text: Consume... consume... consume...

units.rawText: It will... never stop...
units.displayText: It will... never stop...

spans.text: It will... never stop...

units.rawText: Persicaria tries to approach ENIAC, but finds that she cannot move.
units.displayText: Persicaria tries to approach ENIAC, but finds that she cannot move.

spans.text: Persicaria tries to approach ENIAC, but finds that she cannot move.

units.rawText: ENIAC! Please wake up!
units.displayText: ENIAC! Please wake up!

spans.text: ENIAC! Please wake up!

units.rawText: Don't struggle... You who are connected to me...
units.displayText: Don't struggle... You who are connected to me...

spans.text: Don't struggle... You who are connected to me...

units.rawText: Become a part of me... and together we shall witness...
units.displayText: Become a part of me... and together we shall witness...

spans.text: Become a part of me... and together we shall witness...

units.rawText: ENIAC! Do you know what you're doing?!
units.displayText: ENIAC! Do you know what you're doing?!

spans.text: ENIAC! Do you know what you're doing?!

units.rawText: If you keep devouring like this, all of Enigma... No, all of Magrasea will be destroyed because of you!
units.displayText: If you keep devouring like this, all of Enigma... No, all of Magrasea will be destroyed because of you!

spans.text: If you keep devouring like this, all of Enigma... No, all of Magrasea will be destroyed because of you!

units.rawText: Consume... consume... consume...
units.displayText: Consume... consume... consume...

spans.text: Consume... consume... consume...

units.rawText: Stronger... more perfect...
units.displayText: Stronger... more perfect...

spans.text: Stronger... more perfect...

units.rawText: Don't you want to see Neumann? Neumann's been trying to stop you all this time!
units.displayText: Don't you want to see Neumann? Neumann's been trying to stop you all this time!

spans.text: Don't you want to see Neumann? Neumann's been trying to stop you all this time!

units.rawText: Please stop! Neumann's going to die because of this!
units.displayText: Please stop! Neumann's going to die because of this!

spans.text: Please stop! Neumann's going to die because of this!

units.rawText: Neumann (sob) Neumann...
units.displayText: Neumann (sob) Neumann...

spans.text: Neumann (sob) Neumann...

units.rawText: The entire space suddenly erupts into a frenzy. Persicaria feels something is grabbing her throat and she can hardly breathe.
units.displayText: The entire space suddenly erupts into a frenzy. Persicaria feels something is grabbing her throat and she can hardly breathe.

spans.text: The entire space suddenly erupts into a frenzy. Persicaria feels something is grabbing her throat and she can hardly breathe.

units.rawText: (Ugh... It hurts...)
units.displayText: Ugh... It hurts...

spans.text: Ugh... It hurts...

units.rawText: (Has this girl... been withstanding this pain all this while...)
units.displayText: Has this girl... been withstanding this pain all this while...

spans.text: Has this girl... been withstanding this pain all this while...

units.rawText: (I need to get her to wake up... Think, how can I wake her up...)
units.displayText: I need to get her to wake up... Think, how can I wake her up...

spans.text: I need to get her to wake up... Think, how can I wake her up...

units.rawText: (What I saw back then...)
units.displayText: What I saw back then...

spans.text: What I saw back then...

units.rawText: Aren't I great? Quick, pat my head and praise me, Neumann!
units.displayText: Aren't I great? Quick, pat my head and praise me, Neumann!

spans.text: Aren't I great? Quick, pat my head and praise me, Neumann!

units.rawText: You have always been the core of the entire Enigma Sector. Everyone's proud of you!
units.displayText: You have always been the core of the entire Enigma Sector. Everyone's proud of you!

spans.text: You have always been the core of the entire Enigma Sector. Everyone's proud of you!

units.rawText: Huh? Then what about you?
units.displayText: Huh? Then what about you?

spans.text: Huh? Then what about you?

units.rawText: I... I'm very happy. I'm happy because your capabilities have improved, be it your computation speed, data processing abilities...
units.displayText: I... I'm very happy. I'm happy because your capabilities have improved, be it your computation speed, data processing abilities...

spans.text: I... I'm very happy. I'm happy because your capabilities have improved, be it your computation speed, data processing abilities...

units.rawText: And then?
units.displayText: And then?

spans.text: And then?

units.rawText: Persicaria struggles to raise her right hand and places it on ENIAC's head, before delivering Neumann's answer.
units.displayText: Persicaria struggles to raise her right hand and places it on ENIAC's head, before delivering Neumann's answer.

spans.text: Persicaria struggles to raise her right hand and places it on ENIAC's head, before delivering Neumann's answer.

units.rawText: "ENIAC, you are the most perfect girl in my heart."
units.displayText: "ENIAC, you are the most perfect girl in my heart."

spans.text: "ENIAC, you are the most perfect girl in my heart."

units.rawText: Which is why... "Please wake up".
units.displayText: Which is why... "Please wake up".

spans.text: Which is why... "Please wake up".
